title: One less thing to check: eggless cakes for Box Hill and Riverstone
summary:
A birthday with thirty guests. One of them cannot eat eggs. Usually that means a separate cake, a special order, an awkward conversation with the host.

Not here. Every cake at Num Nums is 100% eggless — not some cakes, every one, every time. The same cake works for the whole table, whether it is a first birthday in Box Hill or an engagement gathering in Riverstone.

Six sizes, 15 flavours including Rasmalai and Mango, any design you send us — buttercream, fondant or ganache. 48 hours minimum notice. That is what fresh baking actually takes.

Pickup from Riverstone Shopping Centre, open from 6am on weekdays. Order via WhatsApp: +61 425 697 725.
keywords: a guest with an egg allergy at a birthday party
